_readme: Controlled vocabulary of real Quad Cortex block parameter names, built from the official Neural DSP Quad Cortex user manual (https://www.manualslib.com/manual/3537295/Neural-Quad-Cortex.html) plus, where marked 'engineering_convention', standard guitar-amp/pedal terminology already used elsewhere in this pipeline's prompts. This file intentionally carries NO numeric ranges -- confirming real min/max values requires reading them off the physical device/Cortex Control app, which is out of scope for now (see basis field on individual preset parameters instead). Purpose: give agents a real name to reach for instead of inventing a plausible-sounding one. Every agent must still assign an actual usable value; this file only bounds vocabulary, not values.

amplifier.manual_ref: Neural DSP Quad Cortex manual, p.43

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.note: Preamp section gain amount.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.note: Preamp section volume amount.

parameters.name: Bass
parameters.note: Low band of the amp's 3-band tonestack EQ.

parameters.name: Mid
parameters.note: Mid band of the amp's 3-band tonestack EQ.

parameters.name: Treble
parameters.note: High band of the amp's 3-band tonestack EQ.

parameters.name: Presence
parameters.note: Power-amp-stage high-frequency response control; standard on most tube amp tonestacks (real name, ubiquitous on the physical amps QC blocks emulate), not independently confirmed in the manual excerpt reviewed.

parameters.name: Master Volume
parameters.note: Post-preamp master volume, distinct from channel Volume on amps whose real-world analog had a separate master stage.

parameters.name: Bright Switch
parameters.note: On/off bright-cap toggle present on many real amps (e.g. Fender Blackpanel); already referenced in this pipeline's Acoustician prompt.

parameters.name: Sag
parameters.note: Power-supply sag/compression amount, a real Neural DSP amp-modeling control on many QC amp blocks; not independently confirmed in the manual excerpt reviewed.

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.note: Power-tube bias point, affects amp block compression/breakup character; not independently confirmed in the manual excerpt reviewed.

cabinet.manual_ref: Neural DSP Quad Cortex manual, p.44
cabinet.note: Cab blocks are IR (impulse response) loaders, not a parametric multi-mic-position rig -- selection is from a factory or user-loaded impulse library, not freeform mic X/Y placement sliders. Any prompt language describing continuous mic-position parameters should be treated as an approximation of this IR-selection reality, not a literal control that exists on the device.

parameters.name: Impulse Selection
parameters.note: Selects the loaded factory or custom IR file.

parameters.name: IR Loader Power
parameters.note: Enables/disables the IR loader section of the cab block.

global_eq.manual_ref: Neural DSP Quad Cortex manual, p.45

parameters.name: Band Gain
parameters.note: Gain of the selected EQ band, dB.

parameters.name: Band Freq
parameters.note: Center/corner frequency of the selected EQ band, Hz.

parameters.name: Band On/Off
parameters.note: Per-band bypass toggle. 8 bands available.

modulation.manual_ref: Neural DSP Quad Cortex manual, p.46

parameters.name: Rate
parameters.note: Speed of the modulation effect; also called Speed on some blocks.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.note: Intensity of the modulation sweep.

parameters.name: Tempo Sync
parameters.note: Locks Rate to the Quad Cortex's current tempo instead of a free-running Hz value.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.note: Wet/dry blend, standard on modulation-family pedals/blocks; not independently confirmed in the manual excerpt reviewed.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.note: Resonance/regeneration amount, standard on Flanger/Phaser-family blocks.

drive.note: The manual excerpt reviewed does not enumerate per-model drive/overdrive/distortion/fuzz parameter names; QC drive blocks emulate real stompboxes and each native block generally exposes that pedal's own real control set. This is a generic fallback vocabulary for when a specific emulated pedal's real controls aren't otherwise known -- prefer a real pedal's actual control names (e.g. from coros_map.json / user_captures.json context) over these generics whenever the target block is identifiable.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.note: Gain/distortion amount.

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.note: Single-knob tone-shaping control common on simple overdrive/fuzz pedals.

parameters.name: Level
parameters.note: Output level, also called Volume on some pedals.

delay.note: The manual excerpt reviewed did not surface a parameter-level breakdown for delay blocks; this is standard delay-pedal/rack vocabulary.

parameters.name: Time
parameters.note: Delay time, ms or tempo-synced note division.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.note: Number of repeats.

parameters.name: Mod Depth
parameters.note: Modulation applied to the repeats, for chorus-style delays.

parameters.name: Ping Pong
parameters.note: Stereo alternating-channel toggle.

reverb.note: The manual excerpt reviewed did not surface a parameter-level breakdown for reverb blocks; this is standard reverb vocabulary already partly referenced in this pipeline's Sonic Profiler prompt (reverb_type).

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.note: Reverb tail length, seconds.

parameters.name: Pre-Delay
parameters.note: Gap before the reverb tail begins, ms.

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.note: Damping/high-frequency rolloff of the tail.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.note: Simulated room/space size.

compressor.note: The manual excerpt reviewed did not surface a parameter-level breakdown for dynamics blocks; this is standard compressor vocabulary.

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.note: Makeup gain.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.note: Single-knob compression amount, common on simple pedal-style compressor blocks in lieu of separate Threshold/Ratio.

noise_gate.note: This pipeline's Sonic Profiler prompt already outputs noise_gate_target_db; this is the standard control vocabulary for the block that setting feeds.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.note: dB level below which the gate closes.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.note: Time for the gate to close after signal drops below threshold.

parameters.name: Reduction
parameters.note: How much the gated signal is attenuated, dB.

pitch.note: The manual excerpt reviewed did not surface a parameter-level breakdown for pitch blocks; this is standard pitch/harmony vocabulary.

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.note: Semitone/interval shift.

parameters.name: Voice Detune
parameters.note: Fine detune amount for harmony/detune-style pitch blocks.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.note: Sweep/pedal position.

parameters.name: Q
parameters.note: Resonance/bandwidth of the sweep filter.
